ledger: Open academic elective or minor space
Genuinely open 30-EC academic elective period; minor or approved individual courses, with applicable level rules and examination-board consent.
identity: Adopted VU TER Article 7.1 and official annual guide control the ordinary English Business Analytics degree. Both study modes are represented in the two registry rows and share the programme subject. The comparison shows the full-time structure. No separate specialization is required.
accounting: Year 1 has 11 credit-bearing units (60 EC) and the zero-credit English language diagnostic. Year 2 has ten units at 6 EC. Year 3 has 30 EC required courses including the 12 EC Business Case, plus 30 EC open elective space. The 27 entries total 180 EC. Data Engineering is the current required module. The older Business Intelligence and Analytics label is addressed as a transition equivalent, with no duplicate credit.
progression: The full-time English 2026–2027 pathway contains 150 EC of compulsory named study and a 30 EC open academic elective/minor period: 60 EC in each year. There is no formal specialization. The adopted regulations and exact annual XB_0112 catalogue require Data Engineering; the recruitment page’s Business Intelligence and Analytics label does not replace that unit. Bachelor Project: Business Case is one 12 EC unit including Study and Career in period 4, Academic Writing in English in period 5 and the company case in periods 5–6. Entry is assessed after December results and requires at least 120 EC, Statistical Data Analysis and Project Big Data. All third-year students take Study and Career; it must be passed before the company case starts. Academic Writing must also be passed before the project grade is awarded. Study and Career requires attendance, assignments, participation and an interview presentation, with compensatory work for notified absence. Writing requires a passed introduction, peer feedback, assignments and attendance at least five of six sessions including both feedback sessions. Teams of at most five submit a joint report/thesis and final product; each student is assessed through observed work, peer reviews, self-reflection and an individual interview. Assessment weights are analytics 20%, synthesis 20%, creativity 15%, initiative 10%, social skills 15%, presentation 10% and writing 10%. The kickoff, project-management workshop, company visit, four presentations and final company presentation are compulsory; workload is at least ten hours weekly in period 5 and full-time in period 6. Thesis and Placement Regulations apply. The English diagnostic test and required refresher are noncredit. First-year BSA normally requires 42 EC, subject to exceptions. Individual open choices need prior examination-board approval, at least 12 EC at level 300 and at most 6 EC at level 100; eligible university/listed minors are exempt. The university Data Science minor is excluded for Business Analytics students; the specified Business Analytics and Data Science minor or Mathematics educational minor are allowed. Foreign study may include one 6 EC master unit that cannot be reused in a later master. Historical transition rules apply to earlier entrants rather than being stacked into this pathway.
interestAccounting: 96 exact rows in two 48-row sets. Preserve all rows. Correct paired inventory, stadium-price and retailer-offer examples to search-only, with the stable business and finance direction retained. Twenty-two generator-eligible rows, 36 supporting topics and 38 search-only examples or outcomes. No programme directions are generated by career vignettes.
